_comment: Per-test execution duration in ms (compile+exec wall time) from a recent baseline JSONL. Used by tests/test262-shared.ts to assign weighted shards and sort tests within each shard, slowest first. Keeps shard wall-time tight (slow tests run first so they overlap with parallel forks) and surfaces slow-test failures early in CI logs. Tests not in this map use the runner's default weight for assignment and run after the timed ones in natural order. Refresh with: node scripts/refresh-slow-tests.mjs
_source: median of six successful post-#3461 merge_group runs 29791392339..29799448439 (2026-07-21), fast-nativeharness, TEST262_TARGET=gc, COMPILER_POOL_SIZE=4
